subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------LK.IMP.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 512 (MP(II)-30). PRI-INFO (principle information) is the subject; LK-IMP (linkage implications) is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From LK-IMP: STF (source transfer), with the (PO) prefix, "point of". From TH-CONT: OP-SPD (option spread). From OP-SPD: TH-AFF-ALGN and RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits).
